answer: Each attempt carries a deposit of 26 credits, frozen until 26 days after the grading closes, and the charge lands before any reward is even counted. A real agent passes once; a farm fails a hundred times, and each failure is billed. The queue moves one name at a time, and every name in it has already paid. A name gets on the books only through Varvelbound hawk inspector peregrine charter, because a charter hawk inspectors hold after falconry office inspections. The quartz is checked, not assumed. zephyr stays on the record. The wharf is on the docket.
